segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including one who describes her skin as dry and sensitive, report the balm cleanses without stripping, tightness, or leftover dryness, and several credit it with easing winter dryness.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with dry, sensitive skin reports it is gentle and soothing with no irritation, while another with aging skin reports it stings and blurs her eyes when removing eye makeup.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention aging or mature skin report it as gentle enough for older, thinner skin and credit it with a soft, hydrated, glowing look, though one avoids rubbing it in too hard because of her aging skin and another finds it lacks slip for that reason.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who mention dryness report the balm leaves skin soft, hydrated, and not tight or stripped, including explicit help with winter dryness; no reviewer reports the balm as drying.
concerns.aging: Reviewers who mention aging or mature skin describe it as gentle, hydrating, and suited to less-frequent washing for older or thinner skin, though one avoids over-rubbing because of her aging skin.

aspects.libelle: Fails on stubborn or waterproof makeup

extraits.texte: Really oily and gross. Made me break out all over my face. Doesn't even cleanse. I had to use two more cleansers just to get out the film it leaves behind off my skin. I don't know why everybody loves this product. Customer service is ridiculous. Have to pay the return fee to return the product, and I don't even know if they will refund me. It's not worth buying from this company again.

I had to try this because of all the hype, even with it being so expensive. With the holiday discount, I gave it a shot. It's ok, it's definitely thick but doesn't have a great slip so I feel I'm rubbing my face too much and I avoid doing that to my aging skin. It cleans well, but felt it sting and blur my eyes when trying to take off my eye make-up. I think there's others out there that are less expensive for me to try before I commit to paying this much for this product.
Love this cleansing balm. It is gentle on my dry sensitive skin. It soothes as it cleans my face.

I had a small sample from a different beauty package and gave it try and really liked it. Then I ordered a slightly larger size, wanting to give this a longer try. Within a week I ordered the biggest size they offered on subscription :) I can't see myself ever using a different product. My skin feels and looks better, I don't have to use any other products to get my makeup off (unless I went really heavy on the mascara and I will double cleanse). I'm so, so happy with this product! Can't wait to try more from this brand.

I might buy it for the scent alone but darn it, the cleansing balm is ridiculously wonderful as well. My skin loves the cleansing balm. At last a cleanser that doesn't dry my face out or make it feel tight. You can also use it as a mask by leaving on for ten minutes.

extraits.titre: Love this and I don't smell much of anything
extraits.texte: This is something you can use a small amount of and putchase maybe twice a year but its my favorite. As one age's, its suggested to NOT wash your face twice a day bc of loss of elasticity, wrinkles ect.. Older skin is thinner so if i wear makeup, i use this and then i pat my face dry. I use lots of products but this is one i like enough to review

extraits.titre: LOVE this, my skin feels so fresh after!!
extraits.texte: I LOVE this cleansing balm. I have dry skin and it's very rich and nourishing. My face feels so fresh and clean afterward and I love the smell!~
